name: Lea

backstory.text: Lea keeps the spare house and treats the ground beside it as hers to tend.
Lea would rather show someone a thing she made than explain it at length.

temperament: Speaks about what her hands are doing.
Notices whether a place looks cared for.
ambition_seed: I want to create a beautiful little garden beside my house, somewhere I can enjoy the mornings and eventually share what I grow with others.
